summary: Boreholes from NLOG, the Dutch oil and gas portal: position, tops, deviation surveys and LAS logs, each with NLOG named as the source and the terms of use.

losses: Position from the coordinates NLOG recorded at submission (RD or ED50-UTM31); otherwise NLOG's map point in ED50-UTM31, to the nearest metre
Read from NLOG's public services as NLOG serves them on the day; an older version is kept only once copied in
Every copy carries NLOG's source sentence, retrieval date and terms link
unsupported: tie-in points (kept in the record, not added as stations)
long stratigraphic unit names (unit codes only)
